subject: Subscription Closure Sweep — finance pre-check and risk ledger
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@brightleaf.io>
Cc: BrightLeaf Procurement <procurement@brightleaf.io>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subscription Closure Sweep — finance pre-check and risk ledger

Team / Priya —

As part of our Q3 renewal close cadence I want to run a short checklist to ensure BrightLeaf is tagged correctly in the forecast and that finance has the right audit artifacts. High level asks:

- Marissa: confirm commit tag (Committed / At-Risk / Upside) for this account and the confidence note.
- David: we need the invoice schedule and whether there are any outstanding credits that would alter recognized ARR for July.
- Naomi: please confirm if we need an SLA exception that would change the deal term.
- Priya: can you confirm procurement timeline and whether a PO will be sent before Aug 1?

I attached a mutual action plan and a quick export of current commit tags (Commit_Tags_Report.csv). Please reply inline with short, actionable items. I want to lock the finance forecast by EOD July 20.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightLeaf_MutualActionPlan_2027Q3.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), Commit_Tags_Report.csv (text/csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@brightleaf.io>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription Closure Sweep — finance pre-check and risk ledger

Rishi — quick update:

- Commit tag: P1 - Commit (legal PO in flight, account exec confirmed verbal). Confidence: 85%. Rationale: product usage up 18% MoM and internal budget earmarked.
- Next step: Sales to confirm PO number by 2027-07-15. If PO slips past 7/15 we downgrade to At-Risk and notify finance.

I flagged two line items in the attached MAP where pricing tolerance was used — these are noted in the comments.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

> Attachment reference: BrightLeaf_MutualActionPlan_2027Q3.xlsx (see comments)

From: Priya Shah <priya@brightleaf.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightLeaf Procurement <procurement@brightleaf.io>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription Closure Sweep — finance pre-check and risk ledger

Thanks, Rishi and Marissa. Quick notes from our side: 

- Procurement expects to issue a PO by 2027-07-18; our legal requested one small redline on the data residency clause which is non-blocking for finance (they asked for a confirmation email before PO).
- Finance timing: we must receive an invoice and PO to start the fiscal recognition conversation; projected billing cycle is net 30 after PO.
- If PO misses 7/18 we still expect to close in early Aug but understand that may push recognized ARR into Q4.

I can share the PO draft with Naomi if helpful to speed the audit trail confirmation.

– Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Ops, BrightLeaf Analytics
priya@brightleaf.io

> Forwarded attachment stub: PO_draft_BrightLeaf.pdf (application/pdf)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@brightleaf.io>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:51:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription Closure Sweep — finance pre-check and risk ledger

Team — following up with finance specifics: 

- If PO received by 2027-07-18 and invoice net30, revenue will be recognized in July (Q3). If PO slips beyond 7/31 revenue will fall into Q4. Please treat the 7/18 date as our internal cutoff to ensure ops can invoice in time.
- Outstanding credits: BrightLeaf has a $12,000 usage credit from a pilot overage which can be applied to the first invoice; that reduces recognized ARR by the credit amount in the immediate billing period.
- Action: Naomi, confirm whether the credit applies to the July invoice or should be amortized across the first 12 months. Preference from finance is immediate application, but accounting will accept amortization with a note.

David Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@brightleaf.io>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription Closure Sweep — finance pre-check and risk ledger

David / team —

- Confirmed: the pilot credit should be applied to the first invoice per contract addendum; I uploaded the addendum to the shared MAP folder (link above).
- SLA exception: not required; the redline Priya mentioned is operational wording, not an SLA term, so it won't change the contract term or our recognition schedule.
- I will send a one-line confirmation email to Priya that accounting will apply the $12k credit to the first invoice.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance, Customer Revenue
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya@brightleaf.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subscription Closure Sweep — finance pre-check and risk ledger

Thanks everyone — closing notes: 

- Commit status: Marked as Committed (P1) with 85% confidence in Salesforce. Marissa — please add PO number when received and change stage to Closed-Won.
- Finance: David/Naomi agreed to apply $12,000 credit to first invoice — Naomi will confirm by separate email to procurement.
- External: Priya confirmed PO target date 2027-07-18; procurement to share PO draft with Naomi for audit trail.
- Impact to forecast: Recognized ARR for July subject to PO receipt; if PO arrives after 7/31 revenue will be Q4. Financial risk flagged as "timing" rather than "churn".

Attached final MAP (with comments resolved) and the commit export used for the forecast. Please file the MAP in the shared renewal folder for audit.

Rishi

Attachments: BrightLeaf_MutualActionPlan_2027Q3.xlsx (updated), Commit_Tags_Report.csv (final export)
